# Let me carefully track the player's position across recent frames
# to see if it ever moves vertically

print("Player position across history:")
for i, h in enumerate(history[-10:]):
    seg = h.frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            center_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) / 2
            center_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) / 2
            print(f"  Frame {len(history)-10+i}: row={center_row:.1f}, col={center_col:.1f}, boundary={b}")
